## Projects

- [WhatsApp Commerce Copilot](https://sajiddev.systems/projects/whatsapp-commerce-copilot/):
  An AI-powered WhatsApp commerce platform — a React dashboard and Python/FastAPI backend behind
  the Evolution API gateway. AI auto-replies answer catalogue questions using only store-scoped
  products and policies retrieved by the backend, with a one-click Human Mode handoff to a person
  and live stock management. Optional LangChain intent chain; the backend keeps working on a
  deterministic catalogue pipeline when no AI key is present. Built by a four-person squad in
  Comebck Pakistan Cohort 1 (8-week accelerator); selected Top 5 of the cohort.
  Tech: Python, FastAPI, React, LangChain, Redis, Docker Compose.
  Source: https://github.com/comebck-pakistan/cohort-1-squad-margalla/tree/main/whatsapp-commerce-copilot

- [Entropy-Aware Data Preservation System](https://sajiddev.systems/projects/entropy-aware-data-preservation/):
  A PostgreSQL system that tracks state snapshots, records state changes, computes an entropy score
  per snapshot with in-database PL/pgSQL functions, and automatically recommends whether each
  snapshot should be discarded, compressed, preserved or archived. Includes integrity checks, audit
  logs, snapshot comparison and export through a PHP 8 web interface with Chart.js. 10-table schema,
  12 triggers, 3 views. A three-person university DBMS project (Sajid Islam, Azwar Khan, Abbas Bajwa).
  Tech: PostgreSQL, PL/pgSQL, SQL, PHP 8, JavaScript, Chart.js, Docker.
  Source: https://github.com/Sajid0875/adaptive-data-preservation
